o Reducing Repeat Repair Ratio What is Same Symptom Redo? Exit Cmrse Same Symptom Redo (SSR) is defined as Bounce (a repeat repair) on a device for the same symptom type. For example, if a device is presented for repair due to a signal related behavior, and the device is later presented again for the same symptom type, this would be considered Same Symptom Redo (SSR). These repair tips will provide direction on where you should go with the repair and should always be consulted before beginning. Dimming If the device doesn't enter Power Saving Mode, an engineer's inspection is required. Repair tip Please check the device and implement these measures in the following order: Turn off Auto Brightness from the menu bar, and check how the brightness level is adjusted If the problem persists, replace the display module or PBA and check it again, Samsung Care

o Reducing Repeat Repair Ratio Repair Tips and Customer Education Exit Cmrse The repair tips provide the perfect opportunity to educate the customer and can be used as a visual to support the knowledge you share with them. Especially if their issue can be resolved by simply changing their settings or altering their device habits. For example, if they do not know the impact of running multiple apps on their Battery's performance, then they won't know how to improve it. Help them help themselves by educating them on maximizing Battery life. o Samsung Care
